intent: Acceptance journeys only, not implementation claims

journeys.name: Open a private deep link while signed out
journeys.userGoal: Reach intended Finance content after Google or email-link sign-in without losing context.

steps.action: Open bookmarked link
Choose sign-in; one-use next route stored in session
Complete OAuth/OTP redirect; validate session
Return to original filtered results

journeys.success: Signed-in user lands on original private route with query preserved; no raw database permission error or fake empty-state.
journeys.recovery: Invalid/expired sign-in shows Retry, alternate provider and Home links; unsafe next URLs discarded.

journeys.name: Understand financial position
journeys.userGoal: Know how much remains after obligations and what needs attention.
preconditions: Authenticated account; ledger and forecast available

steps.action: See available amount and source label
Review upcoming and unresolved items
Drill into underlying transactions

journeys.success: User can explain balance, period and unresolved issues; totals use ledger authority and explicit forecast assumptions.
journeys.recovery: Pending/unavailable data show timestamp and Retry; never replace real balances with demo money.

journeys.name: Record expense or transfer
journeys.userGoal: Post an accurate new transaction without duplicates.
preconditions: Authenticated with one valid financial account

steps.action: Choose expense/income/transfer and enter amount/date/account
Assign category or split amounts; check currency
Review validation and post exactly once
Confirm entry and receipt linking options

journeys.success: Correct posted ledger entry appears once, amount/category sums reconcile and keyboard focus lands on success.
journeys.recovery: Double-submit disabled; invalid currency/account/category sum blocks posting; network uncertainty checks idempotency before retry.

journeys.name: Find and inspect a past purchase
journeys.userGoal: Search by merchant, text, date, category and follow evidence.
preconditions: Authenticated; at least one prior purchase

steps.action: Open global search scoped visibly to Activity
Enter filters; results update and URL reflects query
Open transaction and receipt evidence
Browser Back restores search, filters and scroll

journeys.success: Correct transaction is opened and Back restores filters, selection and focus; accessible keyboard route.
journeys.recovery: Zero matches show clear filters; server error shows Retry, never 'no transactions'.

journeys.name: Capture and correct multi-page receipt
journeys.userGoal: Create usable verified receipt evidence with clear page/processing status.
preconditions: Authenticated; permission to use camera or file picker

steps.action: Take photo or choose saved images/PDF
Preview, crop, rotate, reorder and review quality
Upload/queue processing with progressive status
Correct merchant/date/items/amounts from image
Match with ledger transaction or keep as evidence

journeys.success: Each receipt has a reviewable image and status; ledger totals unchanged until explicit posting/matching.
journeys.recovery: Permission denied offers file picker, unsynced draft persists locally, upload errors retry without duplicate creation.

journeys.name: Import bank statement safely
journeys.userGoal: Import transactions without duplicates or silent errors.

steps.action: Choose bank statement
Map columns/accounts and preview amounts/dates
Review duplicates, unmatched transfers, and row-level errors
Confirm import with explicit row totals
Inspect imported ledger and import receipt

journeys.success: Counts accepted/skipped/rejected reconcile; no ambiguous double posting.
journeys.recovery: Mapping errors and interruption preserve source preview until deliberate discard; duplicate detection shown before commit.

journeys.name: Budget for upcoming recurring payment
journeys.userGoal: Allocate money for an upcoming bill and see effect on available amount.

steps.action: Inspect upcoming item with confidence and due date
Allocate amount to category and see unallocated remaining
Confirm changed plan, not altered posted spending

journeys.success: Forecast and budget reconciliation visible; no double-counted expenses.
journeys.recovery: Insufficient available funds or changed bill amounts flagged, with reversible budget correction.

journeys.name: Investigate price or spending change
journeys.userGoal: Understand why groceries or a merchant cost more.

steps.action: Compare periods and choose change driver
Drill into category breakdown
Compare merchant contribution
Inspect product/unit price and source receipts
Open original transaction evidence

journeys.success: Results use stable period/currency units and distinguish quantity from unit-price changes.
journeys.recovery: Insufficient data explicitly indicated; a time period without evidence is not a claimed price increase.

journeys.name: Inspect balances and net worth
journeys.userGoal: Differentiate account cash, asset valuations and spending.

steps.action: Review account balances and statement freshness
Check postings/reconciliation for one account
Inspect asset/liability movements

journeys.success: Net worth and account ledger are correctly labelled, with non-posted valuations separate.
journeys.recovery: Stale or missing balances carry last-updated status and are not silently treated as zero.

journeys.name: Safely create or change categorization rule
journeys.userGoal: Automate merchant classification without accidental past-wide changes.

steps.action: Choose conditions and category
Preview matched past transactions and excluded results
Confirm whether rule is future-only or retroactive
Review affected transactions and undo if supported

journeys.success: Rule applies to disclosed scope only; persisted change has audit/undo affordance.
journeys.recovery: Conflicting rules, permission errors and unexpected matches show explicit errors rather than silently creating rules.

journeys.name: Ask finance about a calculated amount
journeys.userGoal: Get concise evidence-linked insight, without dependency on ChatGPT subscription.

steps.action: Select time period / metric
Ask a finance question with preserved context
Inspect cited underlying transactions

journeys.success: Money calculations are derived from authoritative read model, AI is optional and evidence links restore filters.
journeys.recovery: Without AI, supported deterministic questions continue to work; unsupported request gets a clear limitation.

journeys.name: Recover from expired session during task
journeys.userGoal: Avoid data loss and silently failed financial writes.

steps.action: Edit a transaction draft
Recover authentication after blocked write without losing safe local draft
Resume saved draft after user verification

journeys.success: No unauthenticated mutation occurs and user can recover or deliberately discard safe draft.
journeys.recovery: Auth callback failure never leaks internal RPC details; privacy-sensitive drafts cleared by explicit user choice.
